# COMPLETED-SHARDS-BOUNDARY-PLACED-LIST — the Maps geography-ready candidate set

**This is NOT final SEO eligibility.** It is the *Maps geography-ready candidate set*: the ZIP
pages of the 13 completed N5 acquisition shards that satisfy **both** gates —

- `pending = 0` — **ACQUISITION_UNBLOCKED**. No candidate development on this page could still
  gain authoritative geometry by waiting. Terminal/unverifiable projects are disclosed per page
  and deliberately do not block (a gate nobody can pass is not a gate).
- `boundary_placement = COMPLETE` — **BOUNDARY_PLACED**. Exact boundary-first membership has
  actually executed for this ZIP's prefix, so `placed_by_polygon` is a measurement. Before a
  successful run it is NOT MEASURED, never 0.

A page on this list is a **SEO_CANDIDATE**: it still has to clear whatever SEO and content gates
are applied later. Nothing here says a page is live, indexable, or being read boundary-first —
**the Maps read path has not been switched** and still reads the legacy association set.

Definition of record: `scripts/n5_zip_coverage.sql` and the per-page artifact
`docs/maps-coverage/completed-shards-zip-coverage.csv` (fingerprinted against the database).

**Count: 424 ZIP pages** (of 424 measured — every page on the artifact qualifies).

Derived from the artifact, never hand-listed:
`awk -F, 'NR>1 && $5==0 && $7=="COMPLETE" {print $1}' completed-shards-zip-coverage.csv`
